note: The Shire market directory names eight markets. The Red Hill entry reads "Hill & Ridge Community Market, Red Hill" at "184 Arthurs Seat Road". No market named Red Hill Market or Red Hill Community Market appears anywhere on the page; the Mount Martha Briars Market is listed separately at 450 Nepean Highway. Read first hand on 2026-09-14. What is recorded here is what the page lists and what it does not - the absence is reported as an absence, and the landholder relationship is not inferred from it.
